description: macOS Portal client: the Apple profiles' static composition (every first-party module linked into the app), SDL3 and the native Vulkan renderer over MoltenVK. It replaces the legacy macOS build (Carbon, AppKit, CGL/ToGL, OpenAL), which was removed (user direction, 2026-10-05). Built on a Linux host with the iOS profile's pinned host toolchain; signed on a Mac.

intent.composition: static: no first-party shared library or module search path, as on iOS (AGENTS.md 'Platform-compliant composition'); one Apple composition policy (agent decision under the user's direction to share the iOS path, 2026-10-05)
intent.vulkan_implementation: MoltenVK (Vulkan portability subset over Metal), statically linked
intent.audio_provider: SDL3 playback and voice recording, as on iOS and Linux; the AudioQueue and OpenAL providers were macOS-only and are removed
intent.physics_provider: vphysics_box3d (Box3D) by default, as on iOS (launcher_main/apple_main.cpp); vphysics (IVP) is linked too
intent.app_root: launcher_main/apple_main.cpp (shared with iOS and tvOS) with launcher_main/apple_app_macos.cpp: a desktop window whose mode and UI come from the player's configuration
intent.platform_services: none bound: the game modules keep their file record store, as on the Linux desktop. Game Center's presentation is UIKit only (platform/apple/game_center_achievements.mm).
intent.support_scope: North-star target (AGENTS.md macOS row, runner optional by user decision 2026-09-25). An unsigned app builds on Linux; no run, package or distribution evidence yet.
intent.packaging: .app assembled on Linux by build-macos-app.sh (build-apple-app.sh with this profile); codesign on the Mac. Licensed Portal content is copied into ~/Library/Application Support/<bundle id>/ separately.
intent.deployment_target_reason: 13.0 (Ventura): every Apple-silicon Mac it targets runs it, and it is above SDL3's and MoltenVK's macOS minima (MoltenVK's slice is built for 10.15). Agent decision, 2026-10-05; revisit before a distribution build.

macos.bundle_id_reason: The iOS and tvOS profiles' bundle id, so one app record can carry every Apple platform (universal purchase). Agent decision, 2026-10-05.
macos.microphone_usage: Voice chat records from the microphone.
macos.note: Info.plist is generated from these keys by build-apple-app.sh. AppKit, IOKit and the frameworks after it reach the link through SDL3's and MoltenVK's pkg-config files, not engine code.

sdk.name: MacOSX.sdk
sdk.source: copied from Xcode on the user's Mac (xcrun --sdk macosx --show-sdk-path); never downloaded by the build
sdk.licence_note: Apple's Xcode licence covers use of the SDK on Apple-branded computers; placing it on the Linux build host follows the user's decision for the iOS and tvOS SDKs (2026-09-25).

host_toolchain.note: One pin for every Apple target: the iOS profile's LLVM (AArch64), ld64.lld and cctools-port ld64 target macOS with the arm64-apple-macos triple. tools/ios/build_toolchain.py builds it.

moltenvk.note: The tvOS profile's all-platforms archive (the v1.4.2 release has no macOS-only archive); its macOS static slice is universal (arm64 and x86_64), and the app links its arm64 half.

sdl3.note: The iOS profile's archive and sha256; built as a static library for macOS.

ktx_software.note: The Android profile's archive, sha256 and CMake options, as on iOS.

vendored.source: thirdparty submodule (revision pinned by the superproject)
vendored.note: Cross-built as static libraries like the iOS profile; zlib, bzip2 and iconv come from the SDK.

content.location: ~/Library/Application Support/<bundle id>/ (launcher_main/apple_app_macos.cpp), created at first start; copied by the player

required_checks: build-macos-app.sh (build-apple-app.sh --profile this file): the shared pinned host toolchain, macOS dependency builds, Waf engine build
tools/quality/static_composition.py check on the macOS tree: Mach-O module isolation, no first-party dylib, every module linked
the link map holds no Carbon, OpenGL or AGL framework and no first-party dylib
startup on an Apple-silicon Mac with no first-party dylib or module search path: window, input, audio, a rendered map
window resize, fullscreen toggle, display change and app hide/unhide (surface recreation)
codesigned bundle that Gatekeeper accepts for the selected distribution channel

known_blockers: No run: the user's macOS VM (x86_64, VMware SVGA) has no Metal device, so MoltenVK cannot start there; a run needs an Apple-silicon Mac.
No platform achievement service on macOS (Game Center presentation is UIKit only).

app_icon.note: Portal key art (1950x1097 JPEG, the Nintendo eShop store image), chosen by the user (2026-09-26) for the home-screen icons. Not committed: fetched and verified by sha256 like the other pins, and made into the app's asset catalog by tools/ios/app_icons.py; build-ios-app.sh compiles it with actool on the Mac. The artwork is Valve's; it is used for the user's own device builds, not for distribution.
